expr: return [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-file-card]')].map(card => ({ name: card.querySelector('.filecard__name').textContent, badges: [...card.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(b => b.textContent.trim()), targets: [...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].map(c => c.textContent.trim()).slice(0, 6) }));

return { done: document.querySelectorAll('[data-state=done]').length, error: document.querySelectorAll('[data-state=error]').length, results: [...document.querySelectorAll('.result')].map(r => ({ name: r.querySelector('.result__name')?.textContent, badges: [...r.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(b => b.textContent.trim()) })), errors: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-status=fail] .case__detail')].map(e => e.textContent.slice(0, 120)), notes: [...document.querySelectorAll('.case__detail')].map(e => e.textContent.slice(0, 90)).slice(0, 12) };
